It succeeded the old [[Egyptian Second Division]], which was abolished and replaced with the new Second Division A and [[Egyptian Second Division B|Second Division B]] as the new second and third-tier leagues, respectively, with the latter retaining the format used by the abolished league.{{cite web |url=https://www.yallakora.com/egyptian-league/2795/News/432849/-%D8%AA%D8%B7%D8%A8%D9%8A%D9%82-%D8%AF%D9%88%D8%B1%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%85%D8%AD%D8%AA%D8%B1%D9%81%D9%8A%D9%86-%D9%86%D8%B8%D8%A7%D9%85-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%B5%D8%B9%D9%88%D8%AF-%D9%88%D8%A7%D9%84%D9%87%D8%A8%D9%88%D8%B7-%D9%81%D9%8A-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AF%D8%B1%D8%AC%D8%A9-%D8%A7%D9%84%D8%AB%D8%A7%D9%86%D9%8A%D8%A9 |title=تطبيق دوري المحترفين! نظام الصعود والهبوط في الدرجة الثانية |trans-title=New professional league! EFA announce second division new promotion and relegation rules |website=Yalla Kora |language=Arabic |date=2 October 2022 |access-date=17 May 2023}} Fixtures for the 2023–24 season were announced on 22 August 2023.{{cite web |url=https://www.filgoal.com/articles/467798/ |title=الكشف عن قرعة النسخة الأولى من دوري المحترفين |trans-title=Draw for professional league inaugural season held |website=[[FilGoal]] |language=Arabic |date=22 August 2023 |access-date=22 August 2023}} The season started on 24 September 2023, and concluded on 26 June 2024. [[Petrojet SC|Petrojet]] were crowned champions of the first edition of the league with three matches to spare, following a 3–0 win over [[Raya Ghazl Kafr El Dawar SC|Raya Ghazl Kafr El Dawar]] on 16 April 2024, and secured promotion back to the [[Egyptian Premier League]] after a four-year absence.{{cite web |url=https://www.kingfut.com/2024/04/16/petrojet-promotion-premier-league/ |title=Petrojet secure promotion back to Egyptian Premier League |website=[[KingFut]] |date=16 April 2024 |access-date=6 May 2024}} They were joined by [[Ghazl El Mahalla SC|Ghazl El Mahalla]] (runners-up) and [[Haras El Hodoud SC|Haras El Hodoud]] (promotion play-offs winners), who both suffered an immediate return to the league after getting relegated in the previous season.{{cite web |url=https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/523299.aspx |title=Ghazl El Mahalla back to Premier League after one-year absence |website=[[Al-Ahram|Al Ahram Online]] |date=8 May 2024 |access-date=26 June 2024}}{{cite web |url=https://english.ahram.org.eg/News/526127.aspx |title=Harras El Hodoud promoted to Premier League after one-year absence |website=[[Al-Ahram|Al Ahram Online]] |date=26 June 2024 |access-date=26 June 2024}} ==Format== The league consist of 20 teams in one group.{{cite web |url=https://www.vetogate.com/4906996 |title=نظام التأهل لدوري المحترفين قبل الجولة الأخيرة بالقسم الثاني |trans-title=One week before the end of the season: Here's how the Professionals League will look like |website=Veto Gate |language=Arabic |date=13 June 2023 |access-date=15 June 2023}} The final format was confirmed by [[Egyptian Football Association]] board member Ehab El Komy on 8 August 2023, after changes were made to the initial format announced on 19 June 2023.{{Cite tweet |user=efa |number=1688667941179416581 |title=بيان رسمي |trans-title=Official statement |access-date=7 August 2023}} The season is separated into two phases: In the first phase, teams face each other only once in a single-leg tie, then the league split into two groups. Phase two consist of a promotion group for teams finishing from first to tenth, and a relegation group for teams finishing from 11th to 20th in the first phase.{{cite web |url=https://www.almasryalyoum.com/news/details/2952302 |title=عضو اتحاد الكرة يكشف عن نظام دوري المحترفين والقسم الثاني «ب» |trans-title=EFA board member explains new Second Division A and B format |website=[[Al-Masry Al-Youm|Al Masry Al Youm]] |language=Arabic |date=8 August 2023 |access-date=22 August 2023}} The top two teams in the promotion group earn promotion to the [[Egyptian Premier League]], while the third-placed team play against the three play-off winners from the [[2023–24 Egyptian Second Division B]] in a four-team play-off round, to decide the third promoted team to the Premier League. This means that there's a chance for Second Division B sides to skip a level and earn promotion directly to the Premier League without playing in the Second Division A. Teams finishing in the bottom six in the relegation group face relegation to the Second Division B.{{cite web |url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=2AFte_iZj6E |title=في نقاط واضحة.. عامر حسين يوضح كل ما تريد معرفته عن «دوري المحترفين» |trans-title=Amer Hussein explains everything you want to know about the Professionals League |website=ETC TV on [[YouTube]] |language=Arabic |date=19 June 2023 |access-date=19 June 2023}} Later, it was announced that this season's format is exceptional, and will change in the next season.{{cite web
